faqs.title: How do I upload and parse my resume?
sample_questions: How do I upload my resume?
Where can I upload my CV?
Can I upload PDF or Word documents?
faqs.response: To upload your resume in SkillSphere, go to your Job Seeker Dashboard and click the 'OCR & Intelligence' tab (or navigate to /dashboard?tab=resumes). SkillSphere supports PDF and DOCX files up to 10MB. Once uploaded, our automated OCR pipeline parses your text, extracts relevant technical skills against our 139 verified skills database, and calculates your baseline match scores.

faqs.title: What file formats and sizes are supported for resume upload?
sample_questions: What resume formats can I upload?
Can I upload a word document?
What is the maximum resume file size?
faqs.response: SkillSphere supports standard PDF (.pdf) and Microsoft Word (.docx) document formats. The maximum allowed file size is 10 MB. For optimal OCR text extraction and skill analysis, we recommend using clean, single-column text-based PDFs without scanned image artifacts.

faqs.title: How does SkillSphere analyze and extract skills from my resume?
sample_questions: How does resume skill matching work?
How does OCR skill extraction work?
How does SkillSphere score my resume?
How are skills detected from my CV?
faqs.response: When you upload a resume, SkillSphere's OCR engine extracts raw text and compares it against our catalog of 139 standardized technical skills. The system calculates an affinity score (0% to 100%) against each active job opening based on required skills versus detected candidate skills.
